command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
# the tar extracts to ./sidx -- searching /tmp for it walks root-owned systemd dirs,
# whose permission errors make find exit non-zero and kill the task under set -e
tar -xf salmon-index.tar
salmon quant -i sidx -l A -1 sub_1.fq.gz -2 sub_2.fq.gz -o sq -p 16 --validateMappings > s.log 2>&1
cp sq/quant.sf salmon_sub.sf

corr() {  # $1 = kallisto table, $2 = salmon table -> "spearman logpearson n"
  awk 'FNR==NR{ if(FNR>1) st[$1]=$4; next }
       FNR>1 && $5>0 && ($1 in st) && st[$1]>0 { print $1, $5, st[$1] }' "$2" "$1" > sh.txt
  NB=$(wc -l < sh.txt | tr -d ' ')
  sort -k2,2g sh.txt | awk '{print $1, NR}' | sort > a.txt
  sort -k3,3g sh.txt | awk '{print $1, NR}' | sort > b.txt
  SP=$(join a.txt b.txt | awk '{k=$2;s=$3;n++;sk+=k;ss+=s;skk+=k*k;sss+=s*s;sks+=k*s}
       END{printf "%.4f", (n*sks-sk*ss)/sqrt((n*skk-sk*sk)*(n*sss-ss*ss))}')
  PE=$(awk '{x=log($2+1);y=log($3+1);n++;sx+=x;sy+=y;sxx+=x*x;syy+=y*y;sxy+=x*y}
       END{printf "%.4f", (n*sxy-sx*sy)/sqrt((n*sxx-sx*sx)*(n*syy-sy*sy))}' sh.txt)
  echo "$SP $PE $NB"
}
allcorr() {  # every transcript in the kallisto table, salmon's value 0 where absent
  awk 'FNR==NR{ if(FNR>1) st[$1]=$4; next }
       FNR>1 { s=($1 in st)?st[$1]:0; print $1, $5, s }' "$2" "$1" > al.txt
  awk '{x=log($2+1);y=log($3+1);n++;sx+=x;sy+=y;sxx+=x*x;syy+=y*y;sxy+=x*y}
       END{printf "%.4f %d", (n*sxy-sx*sy)/sqrt((n*sxx-sx*sx)*(n*syy-sy*sy)), n}' al.txt
}
read SP_SUB PE_SUB NB_SUB <<< "$(corr abundance_sub.tsv salmon_sub.sf)"
read SP_FUL PE_FUL NB_FUL <<< "$(corr abundance_full.tsv salmon_full.sf)"
read AP_SUB AN_SUB <<< "$(allcorr abundance_sub.tsv salmon_sub.sf)"
read AP_FUL AN_FUL <<< "$(allcorr abundance_full.tsv salmon_full.sf)"
{
  echo "== kallisto vs salmon: does raw-value agreement depend on depth? =="
  echo "depth is the only variable -- same indices, same tool versions, same metric code"
  echo ""
  printf "%-12s %10s %12s %10s %14s %10s\n" fragments spearman log_pearson both_det all_pearson all_n
  printf "%-12s %10s %12s %10s %14s %10s\n" 200000   "$SP_SUB" "$PE_SUB" "$NB_SUB" "$AP_SUB" "$AN_SUB"
  printf "%-12s %10s %12s %10s %14s %10s\n" 15800127 "$SP_FUL" "$PE_FUL" "$NB_FUL" "$AP_FUL" "$AN_FUL"
} > depth.txt
cat depth.txt
# Spearman must be depth-stable: that is the property that makes rank the robust metric.
awk -v a="$SP_SUB" -v b="$SP_FUL" 'BEGIN{d=(a>b?a-b:b-a); if(d<0.05) exit 0; print "spearman moved "d" with depth"; exit 1}'
echo 'DEPTH CHECK DONE'
